jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. IMPORTANT - this is a translucent SECOND layer that will be composited on top of another effect at about 25% opacity and slightly enlarged. Keep every shape BROAD, SIMPLE and OPEN, with large clear silhouettes and generous empty space; fine filigree, small sparkles and thin scratchy lines vanish completely at that opacity. It must read as a MATERIAL and a MOOD washing over the scene, never as a second attack of its own. Keep the saturation gentle - the runtime tints this layer again. Even the final dissipation frame must still show a clearly visible shape, never fade to nothing. The layer is a crescent of wind trailing one long lonely afterglow. Frame 1 a thin crescent forms. Frames 2-4 it opens into a broad sweeping arc of wind with a single long tail of light stretching behind it. Frame 6 the arc reaches its widest and the tail is at its longest and brightest. Frames 7-8 the arc unwinds and the tail thins away. Palette: dusty lavender and deep indigo-violet, warm silver-lilac moonlight, cream - the silver must lean warm and lilac, never blue-green.
